about:
# New Button Animations

This mod <cy>adds new animations for buttons</c>! Try <cj>new animations</c> instead of old, regular bouncy one!

## How to use:
* By default, mod uses <cy>animation 1</c>, however, you can switch between <cp>animation presets</c>!
* Go to <cb>mod settings</c>, and choose the animation you like.
* <cg>Enjoy the mod</c>!

## How to contribute:
* If you are a <cg>developer</c>, go to mod <cr>GitHub</c>, fork it, and make a <cb>pull request</c> with your <cy>new animations</c>!
